scope: Creator request routing, progressive tool schemas, installed Plugin usage, prompt/context budgets and recovery observability

changes.requestRouting: Default request router receives no Action/Authoring Target catalog and defers Composition inspection.
changes.permissions: Tool discovery intersects existing permissions/admission lanes and never grants mutation or takeover consent.
changes.usageGuide: Current application example, installed public prop names, package identity when verified; additive bounded contract. Legacy source is preserved.
changes.context: Soft budget archives only superseded same-query inspections; latest complete pages, source reads, approvals, errors and mutation receipts remain.
changes.recovery: Known logical source paths, current-run read navigation, bounded regex fallback, distinct interrupted/cancelled/error observations.

composer.note: One initial 15-second timeout during parallel validation; standalone retry succeeded. Not an LLM latency benchmark.

focusedPythonTests.note: 324 in the main 19-module run, plus the subsequently added project navigation regression.

validation.creatorTarball: New Python modules, Skill references and canonical contract bytes verified; final Python copy parity checked.

legacyExpandedTests.baseline: Same 41 failures reproduced with HEAD Python sources in the same workspace. Primarily outdated project fixtures and assertions; not repaired in this change.

limitations: No real LLM end-to-end acceptance or before/after latency benchmark.
No Windows machine run; native/logical path boundaries and Unicode/space handling reviewed and covered by focused fixtures.
Running Creator Python processes must reload/restart to load the new implementation.
